But here is the thing, if someone sees a small printing of the handle that person is most likely not going to think gun. They average person doesn't think that way. You don't think gun every time you see a slight bulge on someone do you? Cell phone case, or beeper, or some other device is far more likely a thought than gun. The difference between you and someone else who doesn't carry a firearm, is that you *know* there is a firearm there, and you sort of train yourself to see it that way. The average person doesn't think that way and doesn't see a bump on your hip as a gun. Now, you will have to dress around your gun. There is no escape from that. But that means wearing a slightly larger shirt or jacket. And a maybe one size bigger pants. There isn't a need to go full on bonkers with how you dress. You don't need some elaborate concealed carry clothes system. Just a good holster and the understanding that most people, if they even notice the bump (most won't), won't be thinking gun.
